_comment: Relative locations of sibling components in the merged Veinnovate_Prototype layout. Copy to sibling_paths.json and adjust if your checkout differs — never hardcode an absolute path in code. The model artifact's exact path and SHA-256 are NOT duplicated here — receiver/sibling_resolver.py discovers them from the sibling's own bundle_manifest.json at startup and verifies them against the pinned contract in config/inference_manifest.json.
